source: Transport for NSW - Opal fare schedule (transportnsw.info), server-rendered pages archived as retrieved
licence: Copyright State of NSW (Transport for NSW); factual regulated fares cited with attribution. The transportnsw.info fare tables restate the Opal determination under the Passenger Transport Act 2014.
purpose: The OBSERVED public transport fare schedule for the ptFare charge (GOAL.md requirement 6: a disclosed value is used exactly). Until this acquisition every PT journey in the model was free while car paid fuel and parking and taxi paid the metered fare - asymmetric pricing behind the heavy-rail excess (#98).
note: Fare values live inside the pages' server-rendered JSON payload (the visible accordions are collapsed); extracted_values quotes them verbatim. The 60-minute transfer window is NOT stated on these pages and is declared as literature in the registry.
